<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-APP-004</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Dashboards, rules and reports</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>**Features &gt; Scheduler**</b></div></div>

## Why it happens

- **Enable scheduler** is off for the event.
- The event's type is **Update Firmware**, which does not run in 4.3.0.57. It runs from the release after.
- **Trigger** is on for an event that is not **Generate Report**. In 4.3.0.57 triggers run only reports, and such an event does not run at all. From the release after, triggers run every event type.
- In 4.3.0.57 a trigger reacts only to values posted through the REST API, not to values devices send over MQTT, HTTP or CoAP.
- The start time is in another timezone than you expect.

## Fix it

- Turn on **Enable scheduler**.
- For firmware, use [OTA updates](/docs/user-guide/ota-updates/) on the device or profile.
- For other types, switch **Trigger** off and use **Repeat**.
- Check the start time and timezone in the event.

## Check that it worked

The table's next run time is in the future, and the action happens at that time.
